exposure: Midwife-led care at onset of labour
Obstetrician-led care at onset of labour
outcome: Neonatal intensive care admittance for >24 hours
cohort: The study included 57,396 low-risk term women with singleton pregnancies who gave birth between 2005 and 2008 in the Amsterdam region of the Netherlands.
finding: Among low-risk women, midwife-led care at the onset of labour was associated with a statistically non-significant higher mortality rate compared to obstetrician-led care.
